# hexcore_applications (Data Source)

Read the HexCore applications catalog. Results are ordered by slug, then ID where available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hexcore_applications" "available" {}

output "applications" {
  value = data.hexcore_applications.available.applications
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) Catalog entries in stable order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Image ID as a string.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Minimum disk size in GB.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Catalog slug.
- `version` (String) Image version text.
